timeline_events.title: The Rise of Elizah
timeline_events.description: Following Ethan's death, Elizah emerges as a brutal, solo operator who defies the established authority.
timeline_events.quote: Season 2 opens with Elizah — the embodiment of that pain — rising from his ashes.

timeline_events.title: The Confrontation of Zayn
timeline_events.description: Exhausted after killing his father, Zayn faces the new Sentinels alone until Elizah intervenes to save him.
